data.description:
Test workspaces under `/tmp` are never reclaimed, so a single test-heavy
session can fill the filesystem and break unrelated work.

Measured on 2026-08-20: one session of roughly 25 full-suite runs left 10,697
`/tmp/knots-*` directories totalling 1.5 GB. `/tmp` here is a 9.7 GB tmpfs, and
it did reach 100% during that session. The consequences were not theoretical:

- Agent tool output broke with ENOSPC because the harness buffers stdout under
  `/tmp`, so commands ran but their results were unrecoverable.
- The knots-0f9c agent reported `/tmp` at 100% mid-run from a concurrent
  agent's build and had to wait for space to free before it could continue.
- Two feature worktrees placed under `/tmp` had to be relocated to `/home`
  mid-task to finish their builds at all.

Two independent causes, both needed:

1. The reaper does not cover `/tmp`. `scripts/repo/reap-stale-artifacts.sh`
   walks only `$ROOT/target` (see the `if [ -d "$ROOT/target" ]` block near
   line 40). Nothing ever removes `/tmp/knots-*`. `make lint` and `make test`
   both invoke this script, so the project looks like it has artifact hygiene
   while this whole class leaks.

2. Cleanup is best-effort and on the happy path only. 108 source files end a
   test with a trailing `let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(root);`. Any test that
   panics or early-returns before that line leaks its workspace permanently.
   Failing tests are exactly when workspaces are most worth keeping and most
   likely to leak, so the leak rate rises with flakiness.

There are 85 separate `unique_workspace` / `unique_store_root` / `unique_db_path`
helpers across the tree, each rolling its own path construction. `tempfile` is
not a dependency and no test uses an RAII guard, so there is currently no
single place to fix this.

Suggested direction (the knot owner should confirm before implementing):
- Introduce one shared test-workspace helper returning an RAII guard that
  removes the directory on drop, so cleanup survives panics. `tempfile::TempDir`
  is the obvious candidate; a small in-repo guard is also fine if adding a
  dependency is unwanted.
- Migrate the 85 helpers to it. This is mechanical but large; consider whether
  it should be staged rather than done in one change.
- Extend `reap-stale-artifacts.sh` to also reap `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/knots-*` trees
  older than the same `MAX_AGE_HOURS` cutoff, as a backstop for whatever still
  leaks. Reuse the existing stamp-file comparison rather than adding a second
  age mechanism.

Deliberately out of scope: the pre-existing `git_hooks_tests` ETXTBSY flake and
any other test-race work. This knot is about workspace lifetime only.
